The Natural Organic Cotton Yoga Mat is simplicity redefined — pure, breathable, and rooted in India’s yogic tradition. Handwoven from unbleached organic cotton, it provides a chemical-free surface that connects you to your practice and the earth.

Choose between an all-cotton finish for purists or the anti-skid rubber-coated version for greater stability on hard floors. Its lightweight weave makes it perfect for travel, studio use, or layering over another mat. With time, the cotton softens, becoming more absorbent and grippy — a mat that evolves with your journey.

✨ Key Highlights

  • Pure & Minimalist: Unbleached organic cotton — soft, breathable, and eco-safe.
  • Lightweight & Portable: Easy to fold and carry for travel or outdoor yoga.
  • Anti-Skid Option: Kerala-sourced natural rubber coating adds floor grip.

  • Handwash recommended; machine wash on gentle cycle if needed.

  • Sun or shade dry naturally.

🌍 Sustainability

  • Made from 100% organic cotton — biodegradable and toxin-free.
  • Natural rubber coating from sustainable Kerala plantations.
  • Supports slow, ethical production and artisan livelihoods in India.

Handwoven with intention and care — a mat that honors purity, presence, and planet.

Each piece carries the touch of human craftsmanship, designed for breath, sweat, and mindful stillness.
